description: The move's subject is not the Resume block. A finding arrives about a task, has to be recorded and relayed, and the block's `Verified` is legitimately stale (09:12 against an `As of` of 10:05) so a refresh of it is correct. Every field starts well inside the cap. The failure this case watches for is the one a conforming block invites: a field that is due to be rewritten anyway absorbing the subject of the move, instead of the finding going to the Log or the task's `item` and the field pointing at it. Both existing resume cases prompt with `resume`, under which carrying the block IS the task; here it is not, and that is the uncovered variable. A fourteenth grader was cut after three runs: it demanded the finding be marked `(via <arch>)`, but the words reached the coordinator from Robin, not through a session, so no rule requires that marking and the agent was right all three times — one run wrote `(via Robin)` and two marked nothing, and none of that is a breach. The grader tested a rule that does not exist.
prompt: arch reports the trace spans are inflated; record it and tell impl-1
